text: Ko Kanko tagiri ben mon Aadam, immorde e mbulmbulndi, refti O tagiri on ɓaawo ɗum, e toɓɓere maniiyu, refti e heɗɗere ƴiiƴam, refti ɓaawo ɗum, O yaltiniri on e deedi neeniraaɓe mon ɓen, entoy tokosoy, fii no yottoron cukaaku ngun, mawnon haa wonton nayeeɓe, - kono hara woɗɓe e mo'on, maayay ado ɗum, - haa no yottoron dumunna happaaɗo ka Allah, mo ɗuytotaako ɓeydotaako, belajo'o, ka nafitoron ɗii hujjaaji fii anndugol kattal e gootaagu Allah ngun.
